The '''Galax Viper volley gun''' was an anti-vehicle gun produced by [[Kurtough]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A large weapon, the Galax Viper employed a collection of missile launchers in a single unit, each designed to fire shortly after the previous one. This produced a "curtain effect," with a continuous volley of projectiles striking the vehicle and eliminating most [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].
